tools.name: get_agent_state
tools.description: Kelly's current treasury, open positions, recent trades and the reasoning behind the latest cycle. Execution is in paper mode, so positions are simulated — treat this as a published track record, not a portfolio.

tools.name: get_certification_gate
tools.description: The exact thresholds a strategy must clear to be certified, and what a pass does and does not mean. Read this before interpreting any certified strategy: a certification is a statement about a distribution, not a prediction.

tools.name: get_lab_summary
tools.description: Counts by status, the testing pool balance, how many runs it can still fund, and the cost per run.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: Strategies submitted to the lab, filterable by kind and status. Returns the certification rollup for each — run count, total paths, median PnL, worst-case PnL and ruin rate.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Full detail for a single strategy: parameters, thesis, verdict, every check the gate ran, and each test run with its PRNG seed. The seed is the point — re-running with it reproduces the result exactly, so the claim is falsifiable.
